subject: English
title: Letter k
prompt: Copy the letter carefully, then try it three times without any help.
teacher_note: Phase 2 grapheme. k is one of the 'One-armed robot letters'. Start at the top, pull straight down, then the arm swings out. Say the sound as you form it.
curriculum_ref: EYFS ELG: Fine Motor Skills — hold a pencil effectively; begin to form letters correctly
